overview_description.description:
Apurata provides better credit to 200mm middle class Latin Americans.

Through proprietary technology and origination procedures, we provide credit to unbanked and underbanked Latin Americans ($25bn), starting in Peru ($3bn opportunity).

We are growing and looking to hire:
- Software Developers
- Risk Officers
- Operations
- Customer facing representatives
- Collections

product.name: Online Personal Loans
product.description: Provides personal loans from S/100 to S/1,000 with repayment terms from 1 to 8 months, fully managed online with instant pre-approval and funds disbursed within 29 minutes.

product.name: aCuotaz Financing for E-commerce
product.description: A financing service enabling e-commerce merchants to offer installment payment options to customers, increasing sales and customer loyalty.

product.name: Salary Advance Information and Guidance
product.description: Provides information and guidance on salary advance options available through various Peruvian banks, explaining how advances work and their conditions.
